segment.source: What can you tell me about Foundry?<end>

Foundry is undeniably the safest station in South Underrail. It is utterly unbreachable and, let me tell you straight away, it's rivaling even Underrail Protectorate's Fort Apogee. All that due to a strong position and the indisputable valor of the Foundry Guard, who exist to serve and protect all within the station walls. If you find yourself in any trouble, or need help otherwise, simply find one of the guards and they will gladly assist you.<end>

Ah... you learned about that quickly. Well, few people have seen those things in person. What happened was, some miners tunneled into a cavern and ran into these odd rocky creatures. Those things were incredibly aggressive and the mining operation had to be halted, rightfully so. Some miners were - sadly - killed, and because of that we're on high alert right now. We even suspect that the creatures are somehow... uh... never mind.<end>
